timeline.label: Birth
timeline.description: Born in Ayodhya to King Dasharatha.

timeline.label: Exile begins
timeline.description: 14-year exile to the forest begins.

timeline.label: Coronation
timeline.description: Returns to Ayodhya and is crowned king.

timeline.label: Birth (Mithila tradition)
timeline.description: Found by King Janaka while ploughing a sacrificial field near Janakpur.

timeline.label: Birth (Bihar tradition)
timeline.description: Local tradition places the same event at Sitamarhi, Bihar, rather than Janakpur.

timeline.label: Agni Pariksha
timeline.description: Trial by fire after the war in Lanka.

timeline.label: Birth (Maharashtra tradition)
timeline.description: Anjaneri, near Nashik, is widely held in Maharashtra as Hanuman's birthplace.

timeline.label: Birth (Karnataka tradition)
timeline.description: Anjanadri Hill near Hampi is held in Karnataka as the birthplace instead.

timeline.label: Leap to Lanka
timeline.description: Crosses the ocean to find Sita in Lanka.

timeline.label: Birth
timeline.description: Born in Mathura, raised in Vrindavan.

timeline.label: Bhagavad Gita discourse
timeline.description: Delivers the Gita to Arjuna at Kurukshetra.

timeline.label: Kurukshetra War
timeline.description: Leads the Pandava forces at Kurukshetra.

timeline.label: Vow of celibacy
timeline.description: Takes a lifelong vow so his father can remarry.

timeline.label: Fall at Kurukshetra
timeline.description: Struck down on the bed of arrows.

timeline.label: Swayamvara
timeline.description: Won by Arjuna at her father's archery contest.

timeline.label: Game of dice
timeline.description: Orchestrates the dice game that exiles the Pandavas.

timeline.label: Crowned King of Anga
timeline.description: Made king of Anga by Duryodhana.

timeline.label: Abducts Sita
timeline.description: Takes Sita to Lanka, triggering the war.

timeline.label: Death
timeline.description: Slain by Rama.

timeline.label: Composition of the Mahabharata
timeline.description: Traditionally credited as author/compiler.

timeline.label: Composition of the Ramayana
timeline.description: Traditionally credited as the first poet (Adi Kavi).

timeline.label: Cosmic residence
timeline.description: Held as the eternal abode of Shiva.

timeline.label: Pushed underworld by Vamana
timeline.description: Sent to the netherworld after his kingdom is measured away in three steps.

timeline.label: Annual return (Onam)
timeline.description: Celebrated yearly in Kerala as his annual visit to his former subjects.

timeline.label: Founded Maurya Empire
timeline.description: Overthrew the Nanda dynasty with Chanakya's guidance.

timeline.label: Teacher at Takshashila
timeline.description: Taught and later engineered Chandragupta's rise to power.

timeline.label: Coronation
timeline.description: Becomes emperor of the Maurya dynasty.

timeline.label: Kalinga War & conversion to Buddhism
timeline.description: Renounces violent conquest after the Kalinga War.

timeline.label: Active at the Ujjain court
timeline.description: Exact period debated among historians; traditionally linked to a King Vikramaditya.

timeline.label: Reign begins
timeline.description: Expands the Gupta Empire across much of the subcontinent.

timeline.label: Reign begins
timeline.description: Establishes Kannauj as his capital.

timeline.label: Brihadisvara Temple built
timeline.description: Commissions the great temple at Thanjavur.

timeline.label: Aryabhatiya composed
timeline.description: Foundational text of Indian mathematics and astronomy.

timeline.label: Reign begins
timeline.description: Exact accession year is a long-running scholarly dispute.

timeline.label: Ashtadhyayi composed
timeline.description: Foundational Sanskrit grammar; exact dating remains debated.

timeline.label: Worship tradition established
timeline.description: Village goddess associated with rain, fertility, and protection from disease.

timeline.label: Legend set
timeline.era: Traditionally placed in the Nayak period
timeline.description: Folk hero-deity celebrated in Tamil ballad traditions.

timeline.label: Principal shrine established
timeline.description: Major pilgrimage site for this Deccan folk form of Shiva.

timeline.label: Principal shrine established
timeline.description: Major Deccan pilgrimage site linked to the Parashurama legend.

timeline.label: Legend set
timeline.description: Folk hero-deity of Rajasthan, worshipped for protection against snakebite.

timeline.label: Legend set
timeline.description: Subject of the Pabuji Ki Phad, a long oral epic performed with a painted scroll.

timeline.label: Worship tradition established
timeline.description: Spirit-deity central to Tulu Nadu's Bhuta Kola tradition.
